method: Authored content counts and explicit identity references; editorial quality is reviewed separately.

modules.title: Platform mental models and cloud responsibilities
outcomes: Trace a query through identity, governance, compute and storage.
Distinguish account, workspace, metastore and compute boundaries on AWS.
Choose the next diagnostic evidence without promising an unverified architecture.
startingAssumptions: No cloud workspace is required.
Read a small table and add two quantities; cloud vocabulary is reintroduced in context.
modules.rationale: Request-path and restart examples replace a product-name tour. Two contrasting workloads prevent capability from becoming an invented requirement.

modules.title: Delta tables, commits and snapshots
outcomes: Predict table contents from committed membership.
Separate atomic table changes from correct business inputs.
Explain retention and reader compatibility before promising a historical read.
startingAssumptions: A file holds rows; compute reads and transforms them.
The platform module distinguishes durable storage from a running session.
modules.rationale: One connected file example establishes the mechanism before schema, concurrency and compatibility deepen it.

modules.title: SQL, Python and PySpark transformations
outcomes: Explain a row’s grain before filtering, grouping or joining.
Trace equivalent SQL and PySpark transformations over typed input.
Preserve unknowns and detect multiplying joins with explicit expected output.
startingAssumptions: A row contains fields; SUM adds quantities.
The optional Python bridge introduces records, conversion, functions and assertions.
modules.rationale: Concrete intermediate rows and matching pairs teach the mechanism. Existing complete locally tested code remains canonical and unchanged.

modules.title: Ingestion, quality and changing records
outcomes: Separate delivery identity, inspection identity and replacement revision.
Explain quarantine, cross-batch conflicts and invalid latest state.
Keep accepted diagnostic candidates separate from published reports.
startingAssumptions: A committed table snapshot is different from a source business revision.
Read typed rows and the weighted unit defect rate.
modules.rationale: The five-row baseline and corrected unkeyed conflict remain one canonical authored policy. Visual ledgers reveal population and publication separately.

modules.title: Orchestration and recovery
outcomes: Explain dependency conditions separately from business correctness.
Predict retained, resolved, published and simulated-effect state after failures.
Transfer replay reasoning to order-line cancellations and totals.
startingAssumptions: Ingestion’s corrected publication gate is required: conflict evidence can block without a usable key.
The previous verified report can remain visible as stale_previous.
modules.rationale: Failure locations drive the narrative. The existing executed local exercise is preserved exactly and is not relabeled a Databricks job.

modules.title: SQL analytics and performance
outcomes: Write a metric contract with population, time and exclusions.
Separate queue, execution and presentation delays.
Interpret join/skew/spill/cache evidence and evaluate a controlled performance experiment.
startingAssumptions: A weighted rate divides summed counts; a join can multiply the population.
All timings, user counts and cost units here are synthetic.
modules.rationale: A45-second dashboard has several possible causes. Worked timing and threshold examples teach evidence-led decisions without platform benchmark claims.

modules.title: Unity Catalog, security and deployment boundaries
outcomes: Explain namespace and managed/external lifecycle responsibilities.
Reason about basic table-read privileges with representative identities.
Frame a cloud-labeled access and sharing validation without overclaiming.
startingAssumptions: The platform module separates account, workspace, metastore, compute and storage.
Use the cloud bridge if DNS, route or principal vocabulary is unfamiliar.
modules.rationale: An analyst access case builds from names through privilege conjunctions and negative tests; sharing/deployment are explicit additional boundaries.

modules.title: ML foundations and evaluation
outcomes: Specify target, horizon, available features and a deployment-matching evaluation split.
Calculate baseline, confusion-matrix, precision and recall results from synthetic observations.
Distinguish fitting, threshold choice, inference and monitoring evidence.
startingAssumptions: A row represents one prediction opportunity, not an arbitrary sensor message.
All cohorts, scores and outcomes in this module are synthetic; no model is trained or deployed here.
modules.rationale: The original leakage lesson becomes a worked prediction-to-decision sequence with actual calculations and visible error tradeoffs. This is foundational evaluation competence, not advanced ML expertise.

modules.title: GenAI, retrieval and agents
outcomes: Design a bounded retrieval answer with inspectable source/version evidence.
Separate information quality from authority to act.
Diagnose a failed answer and propose an honest evaluation and deployment decision.
startingAssumptions: You can distinguish source data from a derived result.
No model API, cloud account or code execution is needed; the examples are simulations.
modules.rationale: Each beat develops one mechanism or decision with inspectable inputs. The final changed case tests transfer; preserved canonical lessons provide their original depth and historical anchors.
